name: Message Assistant
intro: You will tell the app about a Fall Kickoff Party, set up an email group, and then work with the ready-made example plan (no AI needed). Nothing is ever sent — please don’t tap the “Open in email”, “Open in Messages” or “Send to …” buttons.

steps.do: Tap “skip the tour” (the small underlined words at the bottom right of the welcome card).
steps.see: The card now asks “How do you want to start?” with two big choices.
steps.tip: A green greeting strip may show at the top for a few seconds. Tap it to close it, or just wait.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”. When a box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.”, tap OK.
steps.see: The card closes. You see “1 · Tell it once” with empty boxes, and under “👥 Your groups” it says “No groups yet”.

steps.do: Tap the box under “What are you promoting?” and type the example.
steps.see: “Fall Kickoff Party” is in the box.

steps.do: Tap the box under “The big day (or deadline)” and pick a date about three weeks from today. Tap “Done”.
steps.see: The date you picked shows in the box.

steps.do: In “Who needs to hear about it?”, type the example.
steps.see: The words show in the box, apostrophe and all.

steps.do: In “What do you want them to DO?”, type the example.
steps.type: come Saturday and bring a friend
steps.see: The words show in the box.

steps.do: Scroll down to “2 · Let your AI build the campaign” and tap the gold “📋 Copy the campaign prompt”.
steps.see: The prompt is copied. A short note “Prompt copied — paste it to your AI” pops up at the very bottom, but in this test copy the purple bar covers it, so you may see nothing change. That is expected.
steps.tip: For this test you do not need to paste it anywhere.

steps.do: Tap “👀 Show me a finished example first” (just under the big paste box).
steps.see: A plan appears below, titled “🥁 Daraja Store — Tester Launch (example)”. It starts with tomorrow’s date and a “Personal heads-up call” marked “📞 CALLS”.

steps.do: Scroll down to the piece called “The invitation email” and read the small line under its buttons.
steps.see: It says “No group named “testers who prefer email” — add one under Groups to address it in one tap.”

steps.do: Scroll back up to “👥 Your groups” and tap “＋ Add a group”. In the box that pops up, type the example and tap OK.
steps.see: A second box pops up asking for the emails for “testers who prefer email”.

steps.do: Type the two made-up emails below and tap OK.
steps.see: Under “👥 Your groups” a line reads “testers who prefer email · 2 emails” with an “edit” button. Down in the plan, “The invitation email” now has a gold “✉️ Send to testers who prefer email (2)” button.
steps.tip: Don’t tap that gold button: it would open your email app.

steps.do: In the plan, on “Personal heads-up call”, tap “mark done ✓”.
steps.see: The button changes to “✓ Done” and that piece fades a little.
The text is copied. (Its short note “Copied — paste it where it goes” is hidden behind the purple test-copy bar, so nothing seems to change.)

steps.do: Scroll up to the plan’s title card and tap “🖨 Print the plan”.
steps.see: A print preview opens: your section 1 answers and groups at the top, then every piece of the plan with its date and full text. Tap “Cancel” to close it.

steps.do: Scroll up to the big “Paste the AI’s answer here” box. Leave it empty and tap “📣 Build my plan →”.
steps.see: Small text under the buttons says “No campaign found — paste the AI’s whole reply.” The example plan below stays as it was.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: Everything is still there: “Fall Kickoff Party” and your other answers in section 1, the “testers who prefer email · 2 emails” group, and the example plan with “✓ Done” on the heads-up call.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then, on “The invitation text”, tap “mark sent ✓”.
steps.see: A brown strip at the top says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” The button changes to “✓ Sent”.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off. Scroll up to the plan’s title card, tap “↻ New campaign”, and tap OK when asked “Clear this campaign and start a new one?”.
steps.see: The brown strip goes away, the example plan disappears, and you are taken back to the top of the page.

steps.do: Look at section “1 · Tell it once” and “👥 Your groups”.
steps.see: Your answers are still filled in (“Fall Kickoff Party”, the date, “members, the O'Brien family”…), and the “testers who prefer email · 2 emails” group is still listed, ready for your next campaign.
